evidence: matching model_variant/variant172_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (groups of dots appear around one of the slot's parts after their delays, gather as one-pixel boxes onto points spread through a sphere in front of the other slot, and then play eight frames of the texture as quads at those points); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-189 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant189_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
